svg.text: One row shape, so the table reprints from the file.
Day 82 typed every column read_sweep gives back, and print_table still read the raw row main built.
Today the live run and the CSV feed the table the same typed row, and --table reprints a sweep with nothing booted.
before: two shapes for one row

g.text: main builds: claims_failed = "a; b" (a string)
read_sweep gives: claims_failed = ["a", "b"] (a list)
print_table split the string by hand:
len(r["claims_failed"].split("; "))
on a list: AttributeError, no .split
and the "fix", len(r["claims_failed"]) on the string,
counts characters: 26 failures for one note

svg.text: after: both paths meet at the typed row

g.text: live run: row --as_read--> typed row --+
+--> print_table
old file: csv --read_sweep--> typed row --+
as_read(row) == read_sweep(write_csv(row))
Only the two note columns change, to lists. The rest
is already the type it is written as. A copy, so the
CSV main writes afterwards still gets the string.
Two-arm and three-arm rows, checked key for key.
print_table(raw row) TypeError: pass it through as_read
--table coverage.csv the parser: "not a known verdict"
--table header-only.csv a header and no rows, no table
--table nope.csv the path, named
each one a sentence and a non-zero exit,
never a traceback
a Day 76 file (claims_unsound None) still prints
